Blazer 24.79 in from collar to hem, 21.14 in across the sleeves, 15.97 in across the shoulders. No real garment was measured: the scale rests on the figure's nametag (the plate is not dimensioned in the regulation). The hip flap pockets, breast welt pocket, sleeve buttons and the line above the cuff are not in the figure and are kept from Vanguard's product photo of the CAP women's blue blazer (CAP4200E), which the outline was traced from before LIVE12-ART 4. Chest geometry: the crest centre is 3.55 in from the centre line (a miniature rack 3 across, 2.06 in, centred on it has its inner edge 2.52 in out); the lapel edge ends at the break 7.20 in down, above the medal slot's top (7.43 in), so the lapel no longer crosses the
